Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.gXwJFISfwojujXhs]{Anima Ability: Frozen Wing}

You cover your limbs in frost, and perform a wide swing around you. Make an Anima Strike against each target. This attack gains the versatile cold trait. On a hit, a creature gains a -10-foot status penalty to their speeds for 1 round. @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Hampered} On a critical hit, they also need to make a Fortitude saving throw against your anima DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.WMOe5bh8Ap92EeDx]{Effect: Frozen Wing}

This attack has the Flourish trait.

target.value: A number of creatures equal to the actions you spend within reach
